name: Version Switcher
description: Jellyfin plugin for Version Switcher. Automatically registers the Version Switcher script with JavaScript Injector and provides server-side Custom Names configuration.
overview: Companion plugin for Version Switcher with server-side configuration and automatic JavaScript Injector registration.

versions.changelog: Added server-side Custom Names configuration, automatic JavaScript Injector registration, Debug Logging, improved MediaSource detection, LG webOS support, and Jellyfin 12 compatibility.
Added server-side Custom Names configuration, automatic JavaScript Injector registration, Debug Logging, improved MediaSource detection, LG webOS support, and Jellyfin 10.11 compatibility.
